headlines.headline: RAPTORS LOCK UP JAMAL SHEAD AS OCTOBER ROSTER DEADLINES LOOM LEAGUEWIDE
headlines.detail: Jamal Shead and the Toronto Raptors agreed to a three-year, $24 million extension tying the guard to the team through 2029-30, as several restricted free agents around the league — including Detroit's Jalen Duren — work through decisions with camps open.

headlines.headline: STEELERS SEND JOEY PORTER JR. TO COWBOYS FOR 2027 AND 2028 PICKS
headlines.detail: Pittsburgh traded cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to Dallas for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick, in a week otherwise dominated by injury reports around the league.

headlines.headline: WEEK 5 HEADLINED BY NO. 7 ALABAMA AT NO. 16 MISSISSIPPI STATE, NOTRE DAME AT UNC
headlines.detail: A 114-game Week 5 slate runs Thursday through Saturday, with No. 7 Alabama at No. 16 Mississippi State, No. 3 Notre Dame at North Carolina, and UCF at No. 20 Houston headlining a weekend several ranked teams face as their first real test.

headlines.headline: BIG EAST KICKS OFF 2026-27 SEASON AS FIRST POWER CONFERENCE TO HOLD MEDIA DAY
headlines.detail: The Big East hosted its Basketball Media Day at the Marriott Marquis in Times Square on Thursday, the first power conference to do so, with its 11 members opening a preseason exhibition slate the first weekend of October.
